observation_summary: The compiler ignored the user-provided charset flag, resulting in output that was always encoded as US-ASCII (with Unicode characters escaped) instead of the requested encoding.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by the compiler failing to correctly propagate the user-specified output charset from the command-line flags to the compiler's internal options. In the buggy version, the output charset was hardcoded to US-ASCII regardless of the user's input, or it was not correctly initialized in the CompilerOptions object. The fix involved adding a mechanism to retrieve the charset from the configuration, setting it in the CompilerOptions, and ensuring the Compiler correctly interprets the string-based charset name into a Java Charset object.
